small_guidance:
- The fused_lse kernel iterates all 64 channels per spatial tile; try larger BLOCK_S (2048/4096) with num_warps=8/16 to amortize the per-channel gamma/beta/mean/invstd loads, and add num_stages=4 configs to overlap the long unrolled channel loop with global loads.
- Hoist the per-channel `a` and `b` precomputation out of the spatial tile path by computing them once per program into registers (single static loop over C populating two length-C register arrays) before the LSE accumulation loop — currently each spatial tile recomputes `a, b` only once but interleaves with the online-max update, so reordering can help the compiler schedule.
- Consider switching the stats kernel to also be autotuned over BLOCK_S ∈ {256,512,1024,2048} with num_warps ∈ {4,8} keyed on S; current fixed 1024/num_warps=8 may not be optimal for S=15876.
large_guidance:
- The conv2d (128×8→64, 3×3, 128×128) is now the dominant cost since fused post-conv runs in a single pass; replace `self.conv` with a custom Triton im2col-GEMM kernel (one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), implicit im2col gather) and fuse the GroupNorm stats accumulation into the same kernel by writing per-(N,group) partial sums alongside the conv output — eliminating the extra full read of x_conv in the stats pass.
- Better: fuse conv + GN-stats + the LSE epilogue end-to-end by keeping x_conv tiles in shared memory / registers across the two passes, or use a two-kernel design where kernel-1 is conv producing channels_last output plus per-(N,G) partial sums, kernel-2 is the existing fused_lse but reading channels_last for coalesced 64-wide loads.
- Switch the layout to channels_last (NHWC) throughout so the inner loop over C in fused_lse becomes the contiguous axis — currently each `tl.load(conv_ptr + n_base + c*S + offs_s)` is a strided gather across channels, costing 64 separate cache lines per spatial tile.
